footer.tagline: Collection tracker and trade matchmaker for stickers, cards, and everything you chase.
footer.notAffiliated: Not affiliated with Panini S.p.A. or FIFA. Built by collectors.

home.heroBody: Cromo is the collector-grade home for stickers, cards, and everything you chase. Track parallels down to the 1-of-1, match with traders who need exactly what you have, and complete the album.
home.feature1Body: Border parallels, Crumple foils, Extras, Coca-Cola subset, Swiss United Edition — Cromo knows every variant Panini ships, and tracks what you own across all of them.
home.feature2Body: Cromo automatically surfaces collectors whose dupes line up with your wantlist. Swap your repeats for the ones you're chasing — no DMs, no spreadsheets.
home.feature3Body: From 1-in-2 blue parallels to the unique Black 1-of-1, Cromo respects the chase. Rarity tiers are honoured visually — common slate, ultra-rare emerald, unique chrome.
